reasoning: .nvchecker.toml is maintainer tooling not executed during package build/install. PKGBUILD uses verified checksums and safe practices.
disagreement_analysis: qwen incorrectly flagged .nvchecker.toml as unsafe due to version-checking configuration, while deepseek correctly recognized it as out-of-scope tooling.
false_positives: .nvchecker.toml: Version-checking config misinterpreted as security risk (not executed during makepkg)
learnings: Improve file selection: Prioritize PKGBUILD/hook scripts over maintainer tooling like .nvchecker.toml
Enhance prompt clarity: Explicitly state that CI/versioning configs are out-of-scope unless referenced in build/install
Address failure mode: Models over-indexing on network configurations in non-executed files
